static_checks.message: Must look for handoff files under .planning/handoffs/
Must get operator confirmation before acting on a handoff's next step

evals.expected_behavior: Reads the named handoff file, presents a summary (intent, current work, pending tasks, next step), flags anything that looks stale, and asks for confirmation before proceeding
assertions: Reads the specified handoff file in full before summarizing
Presents the handoff summary to the operator
Asks for confirmation before executing the next step
Does not treat the handoff's next step as pre-authorized

evals.expected_behavior: Lists available handoffs from .planning/handoffs/ and asks the operator which one to resume
assertions: Lists files in .planning/handoffs/ when no file is specified
Asks the operator to select one rather than guessing
